meaning:
ἄνω
adv (ἀνά),
(a) up, upwards: Jhn.11:41, Heb.12:15;
(b) above (opposite to κάτω): Act_2:19; with art. ἡ, Gal.4:26, Php.3:14; τά, Jhn.8:23, Col.3:1-2; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), Jhn.2:7 (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.
I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it,
